intro: Small, self-contained models for building intuition about quantum states, one qubit at a time, then two, then three. Each tool runs entirely in your browser: nothing you set is sent anywhere, and every control has a keyboard equivalent.

tools.title: Single-qubit state visualizer
tools.summary: Point a qubit state on the Bloch sphere by dragging or by setting its two angles. Aim the axis of any unitary with the green n̂ handle, apply the named gates or a gate you build from that axis, angle and phase, measure the qubit, and read the amplitudes behind the picture.
features: Gates X, Y, Z, H, S, T
Any unitary from n, θ and γ

tools.title: Two-qubit state visualizer
tools.summary: Every vector of a two-qubit state in one complex plane: four amplitude arrows at their true lengths and angles over a heat map of the concurrence, plus the needle that measures entanglement. The same state is redrawn in Schmidt form on one Bloch sphere, where the first qubit's basis is unit length and the second qubit's vectors carry the branch amplitudes as their lengths. Stretch and turn the arrows by hand, press Normalize to restore the weights, and build a Bell state with CNOT.
features: Four amplitude vectors in one plot
Lengths and phases you can drag

tools.title: Three-qubit state visualizer
tools.summary: Eight amplitude arrows in one complex plane, plus the relative-state view: choose a reference qubit and the state splits into two two-qubit branches, |0⟩|φ₀⟩ + |1⟩|φ₁⟩. Each branch is drawn in its own Schmidt bases, so one Bloch sphere carries a plane per branch, and the branch probability sets its opacity. Drag the sphere to orbit it.
features: Eight amplitude vectors in one plot
Two Schmidt planes in one sphere
Lengths and phases you can drag
CNOT, CZ and SWAP on any pair

planned.title: Measurement statistics
planned.summary: Sample outcomes from repeated measurements and compare the histogram with the predicted probabilities.

planned.title: Gate sequences
planned.summary: Build a short circuit on one or two qubits and follow the state through each step.
